cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What temperature did your winning cake need? I'd still enter mine under my name.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want my secret recipe too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the recipe. Just write down the temperature; I'll do everything else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take the note back once I've set the oven. Will you still let me enter the cake as mine?
